name: Baccarat Hotel New York City
positioning: Baccarat Hotel New York, a midtown Manhattan hotel with contemporary, French-influenced rooms, Spa de La Mer and the La Piscine indoor pool
best_for: Travelers who want a base in the center of midtown Manhattan
Suite guests who want a dedicated Attaché to shape their stay

facts.text: The hotel is at 28 West 53rd Street, in the center of midtown Manhattan.
Guest rooms have contemporary interiors with French influences.
In-room amenities include Baccarat crystal stemware.
Rooms are dressed with linen by Somma 1867.
Rooms have twice daily housekeeping service.
The room categories feature floor-to-ceiling windows.
Signature Suites offer accommodations for up to seven guests, with separate living spaces.
The fitness room has Technogym and Woodway equipment and a separate room for yoga and Pilates.
The 53rd Street Boutique inside the hotel sells Baccarat creations and offers private shopping appointments on request.
Dogs are welcomed, with amenities designed for them.
Dining runs from Afternoon Tea to dinner and cocktails, with the Grand Salon and The Bar among the venues.

highlights.text: Spa de La Mer is the first dedicated La Mer spa in the United States.
La Piscine, the heated indoor pool, sits beneath a barrel-vaulted ceiling with Riviera-inspired cabanas, white daybeds and a checkerboard floor.
Every suite stay comes with a dedicated Attaché who shapes the experience before arrival and throughout the stay.
Guests can ride in the hotel's Maybach house car anywhere within 15 blocks of the hotel.
A curated collection of contemporary artworks and Baccarat creations is displayed throughout the hotel.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have rooms with a balcony or terrace.
The Maybach house car covers trips within 15 blocks of the hotel; ask the hosts about its hours.
